CustomField.description: Value of 1 = Goal Met Value of 0 = Goal Not Met
CustomField.formula: IF( AND( RecordTypeId = "01280000000BZvi", ISPICKVAL(Document_Delivery_Method__c, "Email"), (Docs_Out_Date__c - Offer_In_Date__c) * (1440/60) <1), 1, IF( AND(RecordTypeId = "01280000000BZvi", ISPICKVAL(Document_Delivery_Method__c, "Overnight"), (Docs_Out_Date__c - Offer_In_Date__c) * (1440/60) <2), 1, IF( AND(RecordTypeId = "01280000000BZvi", ISPICKVAL(Document_Delivery_Method__c, "2nd Day"), (Docs_Out_Date__c - Offer_In_Date__c) * (1440/60) <2), 1, IF( AND(RecordTypeId = "01280000000BZvi", ISPICKVAL(Document_Delivery_Method__c, "DocuSign"), (Docs_Out_Date__c - Offer_In_Date__c) * (1440/60) <1), 1, IF( AND(RecordTypeId = "01280000000BZwl", (Docs_Out_Date__c - Offer_In_Date__c) * (1440/60) <2), 1, IF( AND(RecordTypeId = "01280000000BkKu", (Docs_Out_Date__c - Offer_In_Date__c) * (1440/60) <2), 1, 0))))))
